about: Lane SIG7 (2026-11-24, decision 424, most-seen first): the next most-seen species aboard without acts of their own, on clips their live v3 rigs have. `coats`: the domestic cat's coat variants (aboard as their own species, parent domestic-cat, basis domestic_parent) had no row at all, so none of the cat's acts; each takes the domestic cat's row, its sleep row and its sentences, less the acts on clips its rig lacks (dig, knead, stretch). The mallard's bath (`bathe~duck`) stays out on the water. Applied by scripts/ark-signature-recipes.mts. Strips: ~/AnimalDex-work/sig7/.

additions.name: Muscovy Duck
additions.quote: The bird spends much of its time walking and grazing on grass, insects, seeds and scraps on land rather than dabbling on water.
additions.line: {aAnimal} is walking and grazing on the grass
additions.held: a swimmer (move swim: `aquatic`) goes to every recipe goal by water (`recipeIntent` mode), and a flock of swimmers follows its leader on the water most slots, so an act on land never starts: the harness found no episode in 90 slots. Needs the trip mode taken from the goal, a schedule change for every swimming bird's ground acts.

coats.why: their v3 rigs have no dig, knead or stretch clip (SIG5's kit acts are on the domestic cat's rig only)

notes.domestic-pigeon: no new act: its own display (court_display, the display clip), sun bathing and preening already run; its catalogue rows left (a flock's clattering take-off, sucking up water, a homing circle, roosting on a building's ledge) need a startle event, a new pose, a flight path or a ledge
notes.daddy-long-legs-spider: held: its rig has only walk, run, graze, groom and sleep; its rows (whirling in its web to a blur, the tangle web it hangs in) need a new pose and a web prop
notes.domestic-rabbit: held: its rig has only walk, run, graze, browse and scan; the binky (a leap with a twist) needs a clip, and the freeze, zigzag and thump need a threat
notes.domestic-goat: browsing up a tree: the browse clip already plays in its schedule's browse beat; the rear clip is the clash's rear (horns forward), not a reach for leaves
notes.red-junglefowl: held: scratch_feed needs the scratch clip, which only the domestic chicken's rig has (graze alone is a peck, not a scratch)
